shows.name: The Dreamliner Show
shows.description: Fasten your seatbelts — The Dreamliner Show is the LARGEST FREE card show in the Lower Mainland! Jetlagged Cards is going all out: 200+ tables across 17,000+ sq ft, a stamp rally, and a full lounge area. Zero admission. Come join us for the most fun you'll have at a card show. 🛫
shows.vendor_description: Secure your spot at the biggest free card show in the Lower Mainland.
shows._comment_showup_url: Commented out — awaiting the new ShowUp link for the 2027 show. Previous: https://app.joinshowup.io/apply/the-dreamliner-show

shows.name: Layover Card Show
shows.description: Our fourth stop for the layover card show! Come shop dozens of vendors, trade with fellow collectors, pull some packs, and hang out with the Vancouver card community. Free entry for attendees.
shows.vendor_description: Grab a table and sell to hundreds of local collectors. Tables include a 6ft table and two chairs. Setup starts at 8am.
